nodes.title: 企业做什么，会计记录什么
nodes.summary: 先理解真实业务，再理解会计数字。
nodes.summaryEn: Understand the real business before interpreting its accounting numbers.

nodes.title: 股票、债券与资金流向
nodes.summary: 区分公司融资和投资者之间的交易。
nodes.summaryEn: Distinguish company financing from trades between investors.

nodes.title: 今天的钱与未来的钱
nodes.summary: 使用同一时间基准比较不同日期的现金。
nodes.summaryEn: Compare cash amounts at different dates by placing them on the same time basis.

nodes.title: 从未来股利理解股票价值
nodes.summary: 估值把未来预期现金收益折回今天。
nodes.summaryEn: Valuation discounts expected future cash benefits to today.

nodes.title: 债券为什么有溢价与折价
nodes.summary: 债券价格是票息与本金的现值之和。
nodes.summaryEn: A bond’s price is the sum of the present values of coupons and principal.

nodes.title: 财务、管理与税务会计
nodes.summary: 同一家企业因信息用途不同，可以有不同利润口径。
nodes.summaryEn: One business may have different profit measures because information serves different purposes.

nodes.title: 会计准则解决哪四个问题
nodes.en: GAAP: recognition, measurement, presentation and disclosure
nodes.summary: 准则不仅规定分录，也规定金额、报表位置和解释。
nodes.summaryEn: Standards govern not only entries but amounts, statement locations and explanations.

nodes.title: 从业务到决策的报告链条
nodes.summary: 先还原业务，再理解数字如何形成和被使用。
nodes.summaryEn: Reconstruct the business first, then understand how numbers are produced and used.

nodes.title: 年报、管理层与独立审计
nodes.summary: 管理层负责报告，独立审计提供审计意见。
nodes.summaryEn: Management is responsible for reporting; independent auditors provide an audit opinion.

nodes.title: 四张报表与附注各回答什么
nodes.summary: 把时点存量与期间变化分开。
nodes.summaryEn: Separate balances at a date from movements over a period.

nodes.title: 投资者与债权人如何使用报告
nodes.summary: 不同使用者会围绕不同决策选择信息。
nodes.summaryEn: Different users select information for different decisions.

title: 会计恒等式与复式记账

nodes.title: 会计恒等式与企业边界
nodes.summary: 资产的来源可以由债权人与所有者共同解释。
nodes.summaryEn: Assets can be explained by the claims of both creditors and owners.

nodes.title: 投入资本、留存收益与分红
nodes.summary: 股东投入与经营积累是两种不同的权益来源。
nodes.summaryEn: Owner contributions and accumulated operating earnings are different sources of equity.

nodes.title: 认识常见资产账户
nodes.en: Cash, receivables, inventory, prepayments and PP&E
nodes.summary: 资产不只是钱，也包括未来收款权与未耗用资源。
nodes.summaryEn: Assets include collection rights and unconsumed resources, not only money.

nodes.title: 负债、收入和费用如何区分
nodes.summary: 欠款、赚取收入与资源耗用回答不同问题。
nodes.summaryEn: An obligation, earning revenue and consuming resources answer different questions.

nodes.title: 借贷方向与正常余额
nodes.en: Double-entry, debit, credit and normal balances
nodes.summary: 借是左，贷是右，增减由账户类别决定。
nodes.summaryEn: Debit means left and credit means right; account type determines increase or decrease.

nodes.title: 投入、借款与资产购置
nodes.summary: 先区分资金来源，再分析买到了什么。
nodes.summaryEn: Identify the source of funding, then analyze what the entity buys.

nodes.title: 现金与赊销中的收入费用
nodes.summary: 交付赚取收入，耗用形成费用，收付可以发生在其他时间。
nodes.summaryEn: Delivery earns revenue; consumption creates expense; cash can move at another time.

nodes.title: 收欠款、还欠款、卖资产与分红
nodes.summary: 现金变化不一定是本期收入或费用。
nodes.summaryEn: A cash movement need not be current revenue or expense.

nodes.title: 从交易分析到分录和T账户
nodes.summary: 分录按时间组织，分类账按账户组织。
nodes.summaryEn: The journal organizes transactions by time; the ledger organizes them by account.

nodes.title: 账户怎样连成报表与会计循环
nodes.summary: 利润接入留存收益，现金流解释现金，期末余额进入资产负债表。
nodes.summaryEn: Profit links to retained earnings, cash flows explain cash, and ending balances enter the balance sheet.

title: 认识财务报表
en: Getting to know the financial statements

nodes.title: 三张报表分别回答什么
nodes.summary: 利润表看一段时间的表现，资产负债表看一个时点的状态，现金流量表看现金的来去。
nodes.summaryEn: The income statement measures performance over a period, the balance sheet shows a position at one date, and the cash flow statement explains cash movements.

nodes.title: 利润为什么不等于现金
nodes.summary: 确认收入和费用的时间，与收付款时间可以不同。
nodes.summaryEn: Revenue and expense recognition may occur at different times from cash receipts and payments.

nodes.title: 收入、销售成本与期间费用
nodes.en: Net sales, COGS and operating expenses
nodes.summary: 售出商品的成本进入利润表，尚未售出的成本通常仍在存货中。
nodes.summaryEn: The cost of goods sold enters the income statement; the cost of goods not yet sold normally remains in inventory.

nodes.title: 从毛利走到净利润
nodes.en: Gross profit, operating income and net income
nodes.summary: 不同利润小计依次扣除不同费用，不能混用。
nodes.summaryEn: Different profit subtotals deduct different expenses and should not be used interchangeably.

nodes.title: 资产如何分类
nodes.summary: 资产分类主要看变现、出售或耗用的时间与用途。
nodes.summaryEn: Asset classification depends mainly on the timing and purpose of realization, sale, or consumption.

nodes.title: 欠款、预收款与股东权益
nodes.summary: 客户先付款可能形成负债；股东投入和累计留存利润则构成权益的重要部分。
nodes.summaryEn: Customer advances can create liabilities; owner contributions and accumulated retained profits are important components of equity.

nodes.title: 累计折旧为什么是抵减资产
nodes.summary: 折旧分摊成本，累计折旧抵减资产账面原值，并不是一笔欠款。
nodes.summaryEn: Depreciation allocates cost, and accumulated depreciation reduces the recorded asset cost rather than representing a debt.

nodes.title: 现金流分类与报表勾稽
nodes.en: CFO, CFI, CFF and the indirect method
nodes.summary: 先分清经营、投资和筹资，再把利润调整成经营现金流。
nodes.summaryEn: Classify operating, investing, and financing cash flows, then reconcile profit to operating cash flow.

nodes.title: 赊销与收款之间的桥梁
nodes.summary: 应收账款是已履约销售与现金收回之间尚未完成的部分。
nodes.summaryEn: Receivables bridge revenue from completed credit sales and the cash not yet collected.

nodes.title: 应收周转率与收款天数
nodes.summary: 用平均应收衡量资金周转，同时结合信用政策解释变化。
nodes.summaryEn: Use average receivables to assess turnover, and interpret changes alongside credit policies.

nodes.title: 第一步：识别客户合同
nodes.summary: 先确定双方约定和交易边界，再讨论收入金额与时间。
nodes.summaryEn: First establish the agreed exchange and its boundaries, then analyze the amount and timing of revenue.

nodes.title: 第二步：拆出履约义务
nodes.summary: 一份套餐可以包含需要分别核算的商品和服务承诺。
nodes.summaryEn: A single package can include distinct promises for goods and services that require separate accounting.

nodes.title: 第三步：确定交易价格
nodes.summary: 合同约定的对价与各项商品单卖价格之和是两个数。
nodes.summaryEn: The consideration agreed in the contract differs from the sum of prices for selling each item separately.

nodes.title: 第四步：按相对单独售价分摊
nodes.summary: 套餐折扣按相对单卖价分配，“赠品”也可能分到收入。
nodes.summaryEn: Allocate a package discount using relative stand-alone prices; an advertised gift may still receive revenue.

nodes.title: 第五步：随控制权转移确认
nodes.summary: 收入随履约满足而确认，关键是客户何时获得控制。
nodes.summaryEn: Recognize revenue as performance obligations are satisfied; the key is when the customer obtains control.

nodes.title: 合同资产与应收账款怎么区分
nodes.summary: 已履约但收款权仍有额外条件是合同资产，只剩时间条件则是应收款。
nodes.summaryEn: A performed obligation creates a contract asset if the payment right remains conditional; a receivable remains subject only to time.

nodes.title: 先收款为什么形成合同负债
nodes.summary: 先收款但尚未履约，增加的是向客户交付的义务。
nodes.summaryEn: Cash received before performance increases the obligation to deliver goods or services to the customer.

nodes.title: 时点确认还是时段确认
nodes.summary: 符合三类条件之一才按时段确认，否则确定控制权转移的时点。
nodes.summaryEn: Recognize over time only if at least one of three criteria is met; otherwise identify the point when control transfers.

nodes.title: 投入法、产出法与履约进度
nodes.en: Input and output measures of progress
nodes.summary: 先满足时段条件，再选择能如实反映履约的进度方法。
nodes.summaryEn: Establish over-time eligibility first, then choose a progress measure that faithfully depicts performance.

nodes.title: 提前确认收入怎样扭曲报表
nodes.summary: 真实收款也不能证明收入时点正确；提前消除履约义务会虚增利润和权益。
nodes.summaryEn: Genuine cash does not prove correct revenue timing; eliminating performance obligations too early can overstate profit and equity.

title: 存货、成本与现金周转
en: Inventory, Cost of Sales and Cash Conversion

nodes.title: 卖出前是资产，卖出后是成本
nodes.en: Inventory and Cost of Goods Sold
nodes.summary: 商品成本先作为存货保留，商品售出时才转入销售成本。
nodes.summaryEn: Product costs remain in inventory until the goods are sold, when they become cost of goods sold.

nodes.title: 商品成本与制造成本怎样形成
nodes.summary: 把为产品形成所需的成本归集到存货，再在售出时转为费用。
nodes.summaryEn: Accumulate the costs needed to produce goods in inventory, then expense them when the goods are sold.

nodes.title: 存货如何结转，FIFO与平均成本
nodes.en: Inventory Roll-forward and Cost Flow Assumptions
nodes.summary: 先用成本流量守恒核对存货，再按题目给定的方法分配已售与未售成本。
nodes.summaryEn: Reconcile inventory using the cost roll-forward, then allocate sold and unsold costs using the method specified.

nodes.title: 存货跌价与可变现净值
nodes.en: Lower of Cost and Net Realisable Value
nodes.summary: 存货价值下降时及时确认损失，不能仅凭预期涨价把存货调到高于成本。
nodes.summaryEn: Recognise losses when inventory value declines; an expected price rise does not justify marking inventory above cost.

nodes.title: 存货周转率与持有天数
nodes.en: Inventory Turnover and Days Inventory Outstanding
nodes.summary: 用销售成本与平均存货衡量成本周转速度，同时警惕缺货与行业差异。
nodes.summaryEn: Compare COGS with average inventory to measure turnover while considering stockout risk and industry context.

nodes.title: 赊购与偿还应付账款
nodes.summary: 赊购先增加资产和负债，付款时清偿负债，不重复确认成本。
nodes.summaryEn: Credit purchases initially increase an asset and a liability; later payment settles the liability without recording cost twice.

nodes.title: 付款期为什么能缓解资金占用
nodes.summary: 应付持有期估计供应商给予企业多长付款缓冲，但计算要匹配口径。
nodes.summaryEn: Days payable estimates how long suppliers finance the business, but the calculation needs consistent definitions.

nodes.title: 现金转换周期与营运资金
nodes.en: Cash Conversion Cycle and Working Capital
nodes.summary: 把库存、收款和付款连成时间轴，理解经营需要垫付资金多久。
nodes.summaryEn: Connect inventory, collection and payment on a timeline to understand how long operating funds are tied up.

title: 经营费用、预付与应计负债

nodes.title: 经营费用如何分类
nodes.summary: 费用按业务用途分类，课件中Operating expenses的简写口径需要结合上下文。
nodes.summaryEn: Classify expenses by their business purpose and read the slides’ shorthand use of operating expenses in context.

nodes.title: 预付费用为什么是资产
nodes.summary: 预付费用代表已经付款但尚未消耗的服务权利，使用后才转成费用。
nodes.summaryEn: A prepayment is a right to services already paid for but not yet consumed; it becomes expense as the services are used.

nodes.title: 保险时间轴：付款日不等于生效日
nodes.summary: 先确定保障开始和结束时间，再把每个期间已经使用的部分确认为费用。
nodes.summaryEn: Identify when insurance protection starts and ends, then expense the part used in each period.

nodes.title: 费用化与资本化：利润如何被提前
nodes.summary: 资本化要有真实且符合条件的未来资源，不能为抬高利润把已消耗费用藏进资产。
nodes.summaryEn: Capitalisation requires a genuine qualifying future resource; consumed costs cannot be hidden in assets to inflate profit.

nodes.title: 服务已收到，账单未支付
nodes.summary: 已获得的服务应在所属期间确认费用，即使供应商账单要以后才支付。
nodes.summaryEn: Recognise services already consumed in their proper period even if the supplier invoice is paid later.

nodes.title: 没有账单，也可能已经欠款
nodes.summary: 期末检查已发生而未记录、未支付的费用，不能以尚未收到账单为由遗漏负债。
nodes.summaryEn: At period-end, identify expenses already incurred but unrecorded and unpaid; a missing invoice does not eliminate the liability.

nodes.title: 保修为什么在销售时估计
nodes.summary: 满足确认条件的保证型保修义务，需要随相关销售估计费用，而非等每次维修付款。
nodes.summaryEn: When recognition conditions are met, estimate assurance-type warranty expense with the related sale rather than waiting for repair payments.

nodes.title: 报表汇总与披露的取舍
nodes.summary: 对外报表会汇总费用，附注帮助理解，但披露深度同时涉及合规和商业敏感性。
nodes.summaryEn: External statements aggregate expenses and notes explain them, while disclosure depth involves both compliance and commercial sensitivity.

title: 利息、所得税与股东收益
en: Interest, Income Tax and Shareholder Earnings

nodes.title: 借款本金与应计利息
nodes.summary: 借款增加负债；利息随占用资金的时间发生，不等到还款日才确认。
nodes.summaryEn: Borrowing creates a liability; interest expense builds as time passes, before payment.

nodes.title: 利息在报表中的位置
nodes.summary: 经济性质与报表列示是两层判断；同一个利息项目可能在不同格式下被汇总。
nodes.summaryEn: Economic substance and presentation are separate: the same interest item can be grouped differently.

nodes.title: 所得税费用、应交税与付款
nodes.en: Tax Expense, Tax Payable and Tax Paid
nodes.summary: 费用是期间金额，税负债是时点余额，缴税是现金流；先分清三者。
nodes.summaryEn: Expense is a period amount, payable is a balance, and tax paid is a cash flow.

nodes.title: 暂时性差异与永久性差异
nodes.summary: 先问差异未来会不会转回，再判断是否产生递延所得税。
nodes.summaryEn: Ask whether a difference reverses before deciding whether deferred tax arises.

nodes.title: 递延所得税资产：本期多缴，未来抵回
nodes.en: Deferred Tax Assets and Later Deductions
nodes.summary: 符合确认条件的未来可抵扣利益，可以形成递延所得税资产。
nodes.summaryEn: A qualifying future deduction can give rise to a deferred tax asset.

nodes.title: 递延所得税负债与税费勾稽
nodes.en: Deferred Tax Liabilities and the Tax Reconciliation
nodes.summary: 区分递延税余额与本期变动，税费公式使用的是本期影响。
nodes.summaryEn: Distinguish deferred-tax balances from changes: expense reconciliation uses period effects.

nodes.title: 永久性差异如何改变有效税率
nodes.en: Permanent Differences and Effective Tax Rates
nodes.summary: 不可扣除的罚款会影响当期税与总税费，但不会留下可转回的递延税。
nodes.summaryEn: A permanently non-deductible fine affects current and total tax without a reversing deferred balance.

nodes.title: 净利润、宣告股利与留存收益
nodes.en: Net Income, Declared Dividends and Retained Earnings
nodes.summary: 利润增加留存收益，宣告股利减少留存收益；股利不是经营费用。
nodes.summaryEn: Profit increases retained earnings; declared dividends reduce them and are not operating expenses.

nodes.title: 基本每股收益与加权平均股数
nodes.summary: 每股收益是利润除以相应平均股数，不是每股发到手的现金。
nodes.summaryEn: EPS divides relevant earnings by weighted-average shares; it is not cash paid per share.

nodes.title: 潜在普通股与稀释每股收益
nodes.summary: 稀释EPS考虑具有稀释作用的潜在普通股，也可能需要调整分子。
nodes.summaryEn: Diluted EPS considers dilutive potential ordinary shares and may require numerator adjustments.

nodes.title: 市盈率如何连接价格与收益
nodes.summary: P/E把股价与每股收益联系起来，但高低本身不能直接决定便宜或昂贵。
nodes.summaryEn: P/E relates price to EPS, but a high or low ratio alone does not settle valuation.

nodes.title: 净利润之外的其他综合收益
nodes.summary: 有些准则指定的利得损失进入OCI，而不是当期净利润。
nodes.summaryEn: Some specified gains and losses are recognised in OCI rather than current net income.

nodes.title: AOCI与完整权益结构
nodes.en: AOCI and the Expanded Equity Structure
nodes.summary: OCI是本期流量，AOCI是累计权益余额；两者通过权益变动联系。
nodes.summaryEn: OCI is a period flow; AOCI is an accumulated equity balance.
